parole.significato: roan (having a coat of a dark base color with individual white hairs mixed in)
parole.testo: From Vulgar Latin *ravidānus, from Latin ravĭdus, formed from rāvus (“grey, tawny”). Or, from Old Spanish roudano, a Germanic borrowing, from Gothic 𐍂𐌰𐌿𐌳𐌰𐌹 (raudai), inflection of 𐍂𐌰𐌿𐌸𐍃 (rauþs, “red”).

parole.significato: shadow (a dark image projected onto a surface where light (or other radiation) is blocked by the shade of an object)
parole.testo: Possibly from the verb sombrar (from Vulgar Latin *subumbrāre), or more likely from Latin umbra (“shade, shadow”), possibly altered by influence from sol (“sun”) (cf.
